newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and October 22 were 4.8 percent above their year-ago level, mostly driven by a jump in barley and malt exports, member-country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain sales rose to 7.943 million tonnes from 7.579 million.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 1.959 million tonnes from 860,000 tonnes during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Malt exports rose to 1.184 million tonnes from 167,000 tonnes.
Commercial wheat exports were however still sharply lagging on last year at 2.164 million tonnes against 3.241 million.
Flour export commitments reached 1.649 million tonnes against 1.868 million during the same period last year.
Commercial oat commitments reached 163,000 tonnes. The EU made no oat sales during the same period last year.
Since October 22, the EU has granted 290,000 tonnes of soft wheat, 38,783 tonnes of barley, 26,180 tonnes of rye and 20,000 tonnes of oats exports through its weekly grain tender system.
